title: US-short §8 全局现金分配 (global cash allocation) governance — const-pins the field set, the ordering keys, the conservative valid_entry_high basis, sequential allocation, and the insufficient-cash→observe floor
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §8 global cash allocation: buildable tickers are ordered by 排名/置信/RR/流动性, occupied cash is computed at the MOST CONSERVATIVE valid_entry_high, allocated sequentially, and a ticker that runs out of cash is downgraded to observe (never over-allocated). The 5 cash_allocation fields are pinned; cash_allocation_status is cross-checked against the action_table column set. Ordering WEIGHTS are forward priors routed to §13.1 #25, not pinned. draft-07 cannot express: field/ordering byte-faithfulness, provenance in §8, cash_allocation_status ∈ action_table, and ordering_weight_calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

allocation_scope.description: §8 input-scope precondition — allocation applies ONLY to 可建仓票 (buildable tickers); it never allocates cash to / rescues non-buildable rows (hold/observe/veto).

ordering_keys.description: §8 allocation ordering keys (buildable tickers ranked by these), byte-faithful.

conservative_entry_basis.description: §8 occupied cash computed at the MOST CONSERVATIVE valid_entry_high.

sequential_allocation.description: §8 依次分配 — cash is allocated sequentially down the order.

insufficient_cash_to_observe.description: §8 轮到现金不够 → 降观察 — a ticker that runs out of cash is downgraded to observe, never over-allocated.

ordering_weight_calibration_item_id.description: §8 排序权重 = prior → §13.1 #25 (全局现金分配排序权重).
